veranderings.rede: 'verbyvloei' is a separable compound verb and is written as one word when it stays together.

veranderings.voor: Dit is die kant van die wal teen die vloei van die rivier in.
veranderings.na: Stroomop is die kant van die wal teen die vloei van die rivier in.
veranderings.rede: 'Dit' could point back to the damkom rather than to 'stroomop'; naming the term makes the reference clear.

veranderings.voor: om te swem, te visvang en te ontspan
veranderings.na: om te swem, vis te vang en te ontspan
veranderings.rede: 'vis te vang' is the natural infinitive; 'te visvang' sounds forced.
'die land om dit' calques 'the land around it'; Afrikaans says 'rondom' and avoids 'dit' after a preposition.

vlae.teks: Die Oranjerivier (Gariep) met die Gariepdam op die rivier
vlae.rede: The protected entry says 'Gariep' stands in brackets only once, at the first mention; the map brief repeats '(Gariep)' after the study block already used it. Probably harmless because it is a brief for the map maker, but a person should confirm.
